thread:
maria: hey team, I accepted the org invite but when I try to authorize SSO it throws a modal error 'Authorization failed - contact your admin'. I also can't see the 'Request access' button on the repo. anyone seen this?
sam: welcome! :tada: which repo are you trying to access? and did you accept using the same browser where you have your GitHub session?
maria: trying to push to infra/infra-ops. accepted via email link in Chrome, but my default browser is Firefox. 2FA enabled.
sam: likely SSO didn't attach to your active session. Go to https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso in the browser where you're logged in and click "Authorize". If it errors, maybe SAML enforcement expects an @redwood.com email or provisioned SCIM mapping.
maria: i tried that in Chrome and see the same modal: "Authorization failed - contact your admin". ssh push still 403. `ssh -T git@github.com` returns: "Hi maria! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access." but git push gives 403 over https.
infrastructure-bot: Reminder: org requires SSO plus team membership for repo pushes. See https://redwood.help/ssh-and-sso for steps.
sam: can you paste the exact git error? also run `gh auth status` and `gh api /user/memberships/orgs/redwood-inference --jq '.state'` to check SSO state.
maria: git error:
```
remote: You must be a member of the redwood-inference organization to access this repository.
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-ops.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
```
maria: `gh auth status` shows: Logged in to github.com as maria. SSO: Not authorized for redwood-inference.
sam: hmm. i can fix on my side. re-sending invite now and will add you to infra and eng-infra teams. also check that your GitHub account email matches the corporate one (redwood.com) or is verified. SCIM sometimes maps by corporate email. cc @invite-bot
invite-bot: Sent org invite to maria@example.com at 2025-11-18T09:42:03Z
sam: once you accept, open the org SSO page and authorize. if the modal still fails, i'll escalate to identity team — sometimes SAML assertion is blocked by a missing attribute (employee_id).
maria: re-accepted the new invite and authorized SSO in Chrome. `gh auth status` now shows SSO: Authorized. I can see infra team membership. tried `git push` and it worked. thanks!
sam: awesome. pro tip: add your SSH public key in Settings -> SSH and GPG keys and set remote to use SSH to avoid cached HTTPS creds.
maria: will do. thanks for the quick help everyone :)
